phrasing_pool: D (pilot/scenario forms; ATC elements drawn from C/D)
basis: R4 takeoff vs landing on intersecting runways (3-9-8, 3-10-4); airports with no intersecting runways use R3
note: KATL has no intersecting runways: R3 (same runway) used instead of R4. Synthetic phraseology from chart identifiers; no positions; no predictions on real geometry. Evaluation harness only. TRAINING split (text only, no TTS); never used for evaluation.
